summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for Customer Invoice Overview redesign and Customer Order Overview safeguards on public URL. Verified grouped customer layout, metric rows, toggle rowSpan behavior, filters/sorting pairing, export include_payments contract, auth essentials, viewport overflow, and production build.

integration_issues.issue: Console still shows expected pre-login 401 requests before authentication.

action_items: No functional fixes required for this redesign scope based on executed tests.
Optional: reduce/noise-handle pre-auth 401 console entries if strict clean-console policy is required.
Optional: if required by release checklist, add explicit test coverage for seed_admin password-update idempotency (not covered in this run).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is extremely large (>11k lines), increasing regression risk; split into focused modules.
CustomerMonthlyOverview is a shared critical component; keep strict data-testid namespace discipline to avoid selector collisions across pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest passed 7/7 including login cookie HttpOnly, bcrypt $2b$ check, CORS credential preflight on /api/auth/login, brute-force lockout, CIO payment summary invariants (126 payments; payment_grand_total ≈ 816050.20), include_payments true/false export contract, and COO no payment fields. Frontend automation validated CIO grouped dual-row UX (single customer cell, metric pills, payment row no account name, rowSpan 2↔1 toggle, footer merge behavior), filter/sort grouping integrity, metric column + resize handles + legacy width-state safety, COO regression (no metric/toggle/payment rows), desktop 1920 and mobile 390 no body overflow with internal table scroll. Production yarn build passed with warnings only.
rca of the issue: No blocking defect found in implemented redesign. One non-blocking observation persists: pre-auth bootstrap requests return 401 in console before login, likely expected due eager auth/me checks without session.
